vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

notes.en: Forward risk cone is favourable (≈17% median upside vs ≈11% average drawdown) — a constructive risk SHAPE the factor axes don't price.
notes.zh: 前瞻风险锥形态有利（中位上行约 17% 对平均回撤约 11%）——因子维度未计入的有利风险形态。

alignment.line_zh: 周线走弱 · 3日· · 日线上行

entry_signal.headline: Partial entry — half size now
entry_signal.headline_zh: 部分入场 — 当前可建半仓
entry_signal.action: The daily turn is already in — a low formed @ 301.65 and price is back above the 10-day average. What's missing is the weekly timeframe confirming, so this is a partial-conviction entry available now, not a pending trigger: take a half position here, or wait for the weekly to turn.
entry_signal.action_zh: 日线转向已经完成——低点于近期形成 @ 301.65，且价格已重新站上 10 日均线。尚缺的是周线周期的确认，因此这是当下可用的部分信心入场，而非待触发信号：可在此建半仓，或等待周线转向。

timing.next_trigger: The daily turn is already in — a low formed @ 301.65 and price is back above the 10-day average. What's missing is the weekly timeframe confirming, so this is a partial-conviction entry available now, not a pending trigger: take a half position here, or wait for the weekly to turn.

levels.label_en: 25% over the 200-day (out of the chase zone)
levels.label_zh: 高于200日均线25%（脱离追高区）

pullback_zone.headline_en: Too far above trend to dip-buy — even the non-chase entry sits 30% lower, a different regime rather than a pullback. Wait for the trend to reset, or let it pass.
pullback_zone.headline_zh: 远高于趋势，难以逢低买入 — 即便非追高入场点也在低约 30% 处，是另一种状态而非回调。等趋势重置，或放弃。

headline.en: Rate risk runs through its market / growth beta, not a distinct duration leg.
headline.zh: 其利率风险通过市场／成长beta体现，并无独立的久期暴露。

detail.en: Own orthogonal rate (TLT) beta +0.05 ± 0.25 — low / noisy precision. Sector anchor (XLK) reads duration-neutral (-0.06). Inflation-neutral.
detail.zh: 自身正交利率（TLT）beta +0.05 ± 0.25——精度低／噪声。 板块锚（XLK）为久期中性（-0.06）。 通胀中性。

caveat.en: Single-name secondary betas are noisy — trust the portfolio aggregate, not any one stock's rate beta (measured out-of-sample persistence ≈ 0.36).
caveat.zh: 单一个股的次级beta噪声很大——应相信组合层面的汇总，而非任何单只股票的利率beta（实测样本外持续性约0.36）。

decision.headline: Extended — don't chase; wait for a pullback
decision.headline_zh: 过度拉升 — 勿追高；等待回撤
decision.gloss: Ran too far, too fast — don't chase; wait for a dip.
decision.gloss_zh: 涨得太快太远——勿追高；等待回撤。

trust.en: Event edge: insider buying (lone FDR survivor) + earnings-surprise PEAD context + revisions — a confluence read, not a standalone alpha
trust.zh: 事件驱动优势：内部人买入（唯一通过 FDR 的因子）＋盈利超预期 PEAD 背景＋评级调整 — 综合参考，非独立超额收益

regime.en: Mixed tape — balanced momentum / earnings edge
regime.zh: 混合行情 — 动量与盈利优势均衡

timing.text: The daily turn is already in — a low formed @ 301.65 and price is back above the 10-day average. What's missing is the weekly timeframe confirming, so this is a partial-conviction entry available now, not a pending trigger: take a half position here, or wait for the weekly to turn.
timing.text_zh: 日线转向已经完成——低点于近期形成 @ 301.65，且价格已重新站上 10 日均线。尚缺的是周线周期的确认，因此这是当下可用的部分信心入场，而非待触发信号：可在此建半仓，或等待周线转向。

decision.conflict_note: Top board rank, but timing blocks a buy now — the rank measures the name, not the moment.
decision.conflict_note_zh: 板内排名靠前，但时机阻碍当前买入——排名衡量个股，而非买入时机。

axes.label: earnings · insider · revisions
axes.label_zh: 盈利 · 内部人 · 评级调整

falsifiers.en: Narrative basket (Semiconductor Equipment (WFE)) is crowded / extended — cap size, don't add aggressively.
falsifiers.zh: 所属叙事篮子（半导体设备（晶圆厂设备））拥挤／过度拉伸 — 控制仓位，勿激进加仓。

trend.label: Trend
trend.gloss: Where price sits vs its 200-day average, and how strong the trend is (ADX).
trend.gloss_zh: 价格相对200日均线的位置，以及趋势强度（ADX）。

momentum.label: Momentum
momentum.gloss_zh: 日线／3日／周线三个周期的动量方向。

extension.label: Extension
extension.gloss: Ran too far above trend — high pullback risk.
extension.gloss_zh: 远高于趋势——回撤风险高。

rel_strength.label: Relative strength
rel_strength.gloss_zh: 相对行业的价格强度——参考。

squeeze.label: Vol squeeze
squeeze.gloss: Compression → a move is loading; direction unconfirmed until it breaks.
squeeze.gloss_zh: 波动压缩——更大行情正在蓄势；突破前方向未定。

volatility.label: Risk & size
volatility.value_zh: 常见回撤 -11% · 极端 -29% · → 建议仓位 0%
volatility.gloss: Expected downside drives how big to size.
volatility.gloss_zh: 预期下行决定建议仓位大小。

macro.label: Macro exposure
macro.gloss: Rate / inflation sensitivity — context, never scored.
macro.gloss_zh: 利率／通胀敏感度——参考，不计分。

catalyst.label: Catalyst
catalyst.gloss: Next earnings date and any earnings/revision edge.
catalyst.gloss_zh: 下次财报日期与盈利／评级优势。
